Take a ride on Europe’s oldest mountain railway on your next day trip to the Rigi. The ride and views of Lake Lucerne are stunning.

On Mount Rigi, you can go hiking, relaxing, swimming and, in winter, sledging and skiing. Adventure and fresh air make you hungry: fireplaces and restaurants are open all year round.

The Rigi is located in the Lucerne-Lake Lucerne Region and is easily accessible from all directions. A total of nine different cable cars provide access to the imposing Rigi massif, which stretches from Küssnacht in the north to Brunnen in the south.

The local recreation area has a well-signposted network of hiking trails and offers activities for young and old. Various playgrounds and a rope park are available to let off steam. Test your skills at mini golf or look over the cheesemaker's shoulder in the alpine cheese dairy. If you'd like to stay a little longer, make yourself comfortable in one of the hotels or guesthouses and be impressed by the breathtaking sunrises and sunsets.

Escape the fog in winter and take to the slopes on skis or a speedy sleigh ride. Those who prefer a more leisurely pace can enjoy the view while hiking or snowshoeing on various snow-covered trails.

## Your event on Mount Rigi

From the exclusive top location in the multifunctional Rigi Event Tent to the 100,000-year-old, unique Gruebisbalm cave, Mount Rigi offers the perfect venue for an event close to nature. The different room sizes are designed for seminars and banquets from two to 600 people.

In the area of technology, we work together with experienced partners who guarantee perfect lighting and a sonorous sound. Creative chefs will cater for small or large appetites with culinary delights. Here, too, you benefit from a wide range of offers. From the Rigi cheese slice to the Gault Millau dish, no wishes remain unfulfilled.

## Supporting programmes

The many different options on the mountain promise a varied supporting programme outside the seminar rooms. Whether it's peace and seclusion or outdoor activities with great views - the day's programme can be tailored to your own ideas. Be it on a wild herb walk, on the toboggan run, building an igloo or making alpine cheese. This not only clears the mind, but also encourages and motivates the participants to creative flights of fancy.
